intro.text: Yo. Welcome to Sunset Studio. Everybody has notes. Nobody has a budget.
intro.cn: 欢迎来到日落工作室。每个人都有意见，没有人有预算。

intro.text: I'm June. I protect the brand. Mostly from the people who own it.
intro.cn: 我是 June，负责保护品牌。主要防着拥有品牌的人。

intro.text: Chad. Client. Visionary. I made a mood board. It's just a picture of my car.
intro.cn: Chad，客户，有远见的人。我做了情绪板：就是我的车的照片。

intro.text: One sunset party poster. Three opinions. Your move, designer.
intro.cn: 一张落日派对海报，三份意见。设计师，该你了。

review.text: Okay, the first draft is up. Smells like a paid invoice. I love it.
review.cn: 第一稿出来了。闻起来像已付款的账单，我喜欢。

review.text: The color works. But the date needs more space. People should know when to arrive.
review.cn: 配色不错。但日期需要空间，大家得知道什么时候来。

review.text: Love the space. Can we fill it with a much bigger logo? Like, emotionally bigger.
review.cn: 我喜欢空间。能用更大的 Logo 填满吗？要大到直击心灵。

review.text: It's an invitation, Chad. Not a missing logo poster.
review.cn: 这是邀请海报，Chad。不是寻找走失 Logo 的寻物启事。

review.text: Beautiful collaboration. Designer, pick a battle.
review.cn: 多么美好的合作。设计师，选一场仗打吧。

bigger.text: There we go. Bigger logo. Finally, somebody understands my journey.
bigger.cn: 对，大 Logo。终于有人理解我的人生了。

bigger.text: The logo just evicted the date.
bigger.cn: Logo 刚刚把日期赶出去了。

bigger.text: Can we charge the logo rent? It's using most of the property.
bigger.cn: 能收 Logo 房租吗？它占了大部分房产。

bigger.text: Wait. Why is the logo so huge?
bigger.cn: 等一下。Logo 怎么这么大？

receipt.text: Okay. Yes. Technically, those are my exact words.
receipt.cn: 好吧。是的。严格来说，那确实是我的原话。

receipt.text: We love a documented creative process.
receipt.cn: 我们热爱有据可查的创意流程。

receipt.text: Let's call it a medium big logo. I've grown as a person.
receipt.cn: 那就中等偏大的 Logo 吧。我成长了。

receipt.text: Personal growth. No extra charge. That's the Sunset promise.
receipt.cn: 个人成长，不另收费。这就是日落工作室的承诺。

minimal.text: One headline. Two fonts. Enough room to actually breathe. Watch this.
minimal.cn: 一个标题，两种字体。留出真正能呼吸的空间。看好了。

minimal.text: It's clean. But could it be clean with, like, more stuff?
minimal.cn: 很干净。但能不能干净的同时，再多一点东西？

minimal.text: Let's keep the clean version. Less stuff, less overtime.
minimal.cn: 保留干净的版本。东西少一点，加班少一点。

deadline.text: Wait. Another revision takes two days?
If we rebuild it around a logo the size of a swimming pool, yes.
deadline.cn: 如果要围着一个游泳池大小的 Logo 重做，那是的。

deadline.text: Actually, this version is incredible. Possibly historic.
deadline.cn: 其实这一版太棒了。可能足以载入史册。

deadline.text: You said that about the last one.
deadline.cn: 你上一版也是这么说的。

color.text: New palette. Same hierarchy. See? A change can have a reason.
color.cn: 新配色，保留层级。看，修改可以是有理由的。

color.text: That's the exact color I was thinking of. Before you thought of it.
color.cn: 这就是我想的颜色。在你想到之前，我就想到了。
太好了。两次想法都记账。

edit.text: Copy updated. The details are finally doing their job.
edit.cn: 文案更新了。信息终于开始履行职责了。

edit.text: Look at us. Making actual progress. Don't tell the client.
edit.cn: 看看我们，居然在推进。别告诉客户。

lock.text: Locking the brief. One title, a readable date, and a reasonably sized logo.
lock.cn: 锁定需求：一个标题、清楚的日期、大小合理的 Logo。

lock.text: Whatever gets us to the beach before the sun clocks out.
lock.cn: 能让我们在太阳下班前到海边的大小。

lock.text: Fine. But I want credit for the sunset.
lock.cn: 好吧。但落日这个创意必须算我的。

ship.cn: 清楚，平衡，符合品牌。通过。

ship.text: You know what? I'd go to this party. Approved.
ship.cn: 说实话？这个派对我愿意去。通过。

ship.text: Three approvals. One actual poster. Yeah. Ship it.
ship.cn: 三份批准，一张真正的海报。好，交付。

ship.text: Quick thing. Can we get a version without any text?
ship.cn: 还有个小事。能来一版没有文字的吗？

unknown.text: Give me something specific. A color, a new headline, or a bigger or smaller logo. I can work with that.
unknown.cn: 给我具体一点：颜色、新标题，或者放大缩小 Logo。这些我能处理。

smaller.text: A smaller logo. Now the rest of the poster can have a career.
smaller.cn: Logo 缩小了。现在海报其他部分也能有点前途了。

smaller.text: I'm choosing to see this as quiet luxury.
smaller.cn: 我决定把这个理解为静奢风。

smaller.text: Quiet is my favorite price point.
smaller.cn: 安静是我最喜欢的价位。

budget.text: Extra revisions cost extra? Finally, a design direction I understand.
budget.cn: 额外修改要额外收费？终于有个我听得懂的设计方向了。

budget.text: Suddenly, I love everything about this version.
budget.cn: 突然之间，我爱上了这一版的一切。

budget.text: Amazing what a price tag does for creative clarity.
budget.cn: 价格标签对创意清晰度的贡献真惊人。

fight.text: Yo, why is my logo so small? I said massive. This thing needs main character energy.
fight.cn: Yo，Logo 怎么这么小？我要巨大。它需要主角气场。

fight.text: It has main character energy. It literally pushed the date off the poster.
fight.cn: 它很有主角气场。日期已经被它挤出海报了。

fight.text: Okay. Nobody panic. We make the logo bigger, and the poster smaller. Problem solved.
fight.cn: 别慌。Logo 放大，海报缩小。问题解决。

fight.text: Rick. That is the same problem, with a worse invoice.
fight.cn: Rick，这还是同一个问题，只是账单更难看了。

fight.text: Look, I want it minimal. Just add flames, palm trees, a lowrider, and my dog.
fight.cn: 我就想要简约。加点火焰、棕榈树、低趴车，还有我的狗。

fight.text: The dog is not in the budget. Neither is the car.
fight.cn: 狗不在预算里。车也不在。

fight.text: We have a date nobody can read, and a logo with its own zip code.
fight.cn: 日期谁都看不清，Logo 已经大到有自己的邮政编码了。

fight.text: You're making it sound like I don't know what I want.
fight.cn: 你们说得好像我不知道自己想要什么一样。

fight.text: You know exactly what you want. It just changes every eight seconds.
fight.cn: 你很清楚你想要什么。只是每八秒就换一次。

fight.text: Designer. Please tell me you saved the receipts. I am begging you.
fight.cn: 设计师，告诉我你保存了原话。算我求你。

calm.text: Okay. Everybody stop. The designer has the floor.
calm.cn: 好了，全都停下。现在设计师说了算。

calm.text: One headline. A readable date. A normal logo. That is the whole brief.
calm.cn: 一个标题，清楚的日期，正常大小的 Logo。需求就这些。

calm.text: Fine. But the dog gets a plus one.
calm.cn: 行。但我的狗可以带一位朋友。

calm.text: Deal. Lock the brief before somebody adopts another dog.
calm.cn: 成交。趁有人收养第二只狗之前，把需求锁定。
